title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Is Chasing God, Not a Girlfriend
caption:
The second one is how you can tell before he can.

He's fine at the wedding, genuinely, not performing fine. He deletes the app before he deletes the loneliness. His prayers don't turn into a resume for her. He can be around her and still be fully present with God that same hour.

He's building a life he'd be proud of even if she never shows up. He asks his brothers to check him, not just to wish him luck. He's not narrating his singleness like a countdown. He wants her to meet the man God's been building, not the man built to impress her.

The guy desperate for a wife reeks of it. The guy chasing God becomes the guy worth marrying.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
